dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。やっぱりそう思うんだ」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「俺もどうもあのカラオケの、一律に盛り上が
　れ！　みたいなノリには時々ついて行けなく
　なるな」
dialogues.en:
"Karaoke is so monotonous! I wouldn't go to it if I wasn't
under any obligations."
dialogues.text:
"Karaoke is so monotonous! I wouldn't go to it if I wasn't
under any obligations."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まったく同感だ。いや、賛同者がいてくれて
　うれしいよ」
dialogues.en: "Same here. I'm glad someone finally agrees with me!"
dialogues.text: "Same here. I'm glad someone finally agrees with me!"

dialogues.jp:
工藤は俺の手を取り堅く握り締めると、同志が
身近にいたことを素直に喜んだ。
dialogues.en:
Kudou shook my hand tightly with his, a true show of
comrades.
dialogues.text:
Kudou shook my hand tightly with his, a true show of
comrades.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あう……お兄ちゃんとくっぴー、１００万友
　情パワーズ結成だね……」
dialogues.en:
"Auu... bro and Kuupi are using their 100,000 power
friendship formation..."
dialogues.text:
"Auu... bro and Kuupi are using their 100,000 power
friendship formation..."

dialogues.jp:
俺たちの様子を見て、さくらもお手上げという
表情で肩をすくめた。
dialogues.en:
Looking at us, Sakura's shoulders fell as she gave up any
hope of trying to convince us.
dialogues.text:
Looking at us, Sakura's shoulders fell as she gave up any
hope of trying to convince us.

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤の意見に賛同した。同志がいてくれた
と喜ぶ工藤。
dialogues.en:
I agreed with Kudou's view, and we quickly became
comrades-in-arms.
dialogues.text:
I agreed with Kudou's view, and we quickly became
comrades-in-arms.

dialogues.jp:
友情万歳！俺たちはがっしと手を握り合った。
工藤の手は柔らかくて｛きゃしゃ／華奢｝だった。
dialogues.en:
Long live friendship! We firmly grasped each other's hands
to emphasize this point. His was soft and delicate...
dialogues.text:
Long live friendship! We firmly grasped each other's hands
to emphasize this point. His was soft and delicate...
